caption: The drawing depicts a female doll with a pale complexion and black hair styled in wavy sections, parted in the center. The doll is dressed in a floor-length dress with a fitted bodice and wide, short sleeves. The dress has a striped pattern combining earthy beige, tan, and reddish-brown tones, with alternating vertical bands of intricate geometric and floral designs in white and red. The neckline is wide and off-the-shoulder, and there is a matching waistband. The hands are simply rendered in a peach skin tone, and the feet appear as two slightly pointed, light brown shapes peeking out from under the dress. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or designs surrounding the figure.
title: Doll's Dress
